description: Implements methods for AccountStateSF to handle storing and retrieving account state nodes in the ledger, interacting with a database and fetch pack.
test_coverage_notes: Direct unit tests for AccountStateSF are unlikely; coverage is typically indirect via SHAMap and ledger synchronization tests. Likely test files: SHAMap_test.cpp, LedgerReplay_test.cpp, LedgerMaster_test.cpp, FetchPack_test.cpp. Gaps: No direct validation or error handling in AccountStateSF methods; relies on upstream validation. Edge cases (e.g., corrupt nodeData, invalid nodeHash) are not handled or tested at this level.
